project_type: Python FastAPI autonomous AI company operating system
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), conftest.py fixtures with AsyncMock/MagicMock
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/ --tb=short -q and confirm all tests pass (baseline: 1230). 2. Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_pricing.py tests/test_provider_presets.py tests/test_circuit_breaker_advanced.py tests/test_hire_manifest.py tests/test_hive_protocol.py tests/test_hive_manager.py tests/test_hive_router.py --tb=short for new tests specifically.
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12. Default python3 is 3.9 - must use python3.12 explicitly. OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker daemon available for testing.
contribution_requirements: ruff linting (100 char line length), type hints on all functions, docstrings on all public classes/functions, Python 3.12 features (type unions with |). Every module independently testable.
key_patterns: Dataclasses for simple data models, Pydantic BaseModel for validated models, frozenset for allowlists, IntEnum/str Enum for type-safe enumerations. Tests use pytest fixtures from conftest.py. Source in src/nexus/<module>/. Tests in tests/test_<name>.py. Modules export via __init__.py with __all__.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package with submodules (adapters/, communication/, governance/, models_router/, templates/, etc.). tests/ - flat test files (test_*.py). data/ - for data files. docs/ - documentation.
